title: Board Resolution on the Declared Patronage Rates and Notice Dates for Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
**Resolved**, that the rates below stand as the declared allocation rates on each class of Membership and Patronage Equity, applied to the member's qualifying units on each stream of business, and that written notice of an allocation reach the member within the notice period the class carries, counted in calendar days from the day the board declared.

| Class | Grain, USD a bushel | Crop input, USD in the dollar | Refined fuels and propane, USD a gallon | Feed, USD a ton | Custom application and other services, USD in the dollar | Day the year's allocation is normally declared | Notice period, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.00 | 0.000 | 11-15 | 30 |
| Class A Voting Membership | 0.045 | 0.018 | 0.025 | 1.75 | 0.015 | 11-15 | 30 |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 0.045 | 0.018 | 0.025 | 1.75 | 0.015 | 11-15 | 30 |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.00 | 0.000 | 11-15 | 30 |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 0.045 | 0.018 | 0.025 | 1.75 | 0.015 | 11-15 | 30 |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 0.045 | 0.018 | 0.025 | 1.75 | 0.015 | 11-15 | 30 |

**Resolved further**, that the declaration day of 11-15 in the sixth column is the month and day on which the board normally declares the year's allocation, and that the notice period of 30 calendar days in the seventh column runs from the day of declaration on every class.

**Illustration on hypothetical figures.** A member whose class carries the grain rate of 0.045 a bushel and who is credited with 12000 qualifying bushels for a fiscal year earns, on the grain stream alone, 12000 bushels multiplied by 0.045 dollars a bushel, which is 540.00. Where the same member's class carries the crop input rate of 0.018 in the dollar and 20000.00 of qualifying crop input spend, that stream earns 360.00.

**Note on the classes carrying no rate.** Two classes of Membership and Patronage Equity carry 0.000 on every stream. On those classes the declared rate produces nothing for the year whatever volume the member did.
